# Personal structure contract

<!-- bp-vault-skills:start -->
- Root boundary: this fixture only.
- Language: Spanish.
- Captures: `Inbox/`.
- Durable ideas: `Ideas/`.
- Applications: existing notes under `Projects/`.
- Reviews: `Reviews/`.
- Links: local wikilinks using the note title.
- Properties: existing `kind` values only. There is no universal status property.
- Mechanical edits: whitespace, broken local links with an unambiguous target, and property ordering.
- Approval: semantic rewrites, new notes, property values, splits, moves, and renames need a preview and explicit approval.
<!-- bp-vault-skills:end -->
